description: Links that download a version of a report as a file: PDF, PowerPoint slides, Word document, plain text with formatting marks, a web page (.html) or a picture (PNG). Send the links to the person: they open in their signed-in browser and the file is made then; you get no bytes. Without part, each link is the whole report, and the answer lists the parts that can be downloaded alone (each slide of a deck, a design and each of its boards) as part ids such as 0:problem. With part, only the files that hold that part alone are listed (PowerPoint holds a slide of a deck, never a board). include_visuals false leaves pictures and charts out of a whole report. Leave version out for the newest version the person may read.

include_visuals.description: false leaves pictures and charts out of a whole report (a part is always drawn as it is). true if left out.

part.description: One part alone, as this tool lists it without one (0:problem is the slide problem of the deck at block 0). Leave it out for the whole report.

version.description: The version to download (list_report_versions gives numbers). Leave it out for the newest.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: download_report
title: Download a report
